title: Stored Procedures & Functions
description: Creating and managing stored procedures (with parameters and output parameters), scalar functions, table-valued functions, and user-defined functions.
longDescription: This module covers SQL Server stored procedures and user-defined functions. You'll learn how to create procedures with input and output parameters, use variables, write scalar and table-valued functions, and drop functions.
whatYouLearn: Use parameters and output parameters in stored procedures
Declare and use variables in stored procedures
Create scalar functions that return a single value
Create table-valued functions that return a table
